title: Conceptual creativity and hypothesis-space exploration for Abducer

visible_workflows.name: conceptual-obstruction-refinement
visible_workflows.end_to_end_function: Adapt Hegelian Solver's crisis, failure, discovery-signal, mediation, obligation, and bounded-refinement ideas into an Abducer-native hypothesis exploration space where creative route transformations are grounded, validated, ranked, and routed through KB, dependency graph, bridge planning, proof queue, work loop, and Looper governance artifacts.

reference_skills.name: looper-workflow-contract-governor
reference_skills.why: Keeps the integration visible as an Abducer workflow rather than a copied external agent stack.

reference_skills.name: looper-target-dependency-cartographer
reference_skills.why: Routes Hegelian-derived pressure and candidate nodes through Abducer dependency closure.

reference_skills.name: abducer-conceptual-pressure-formalizer
reference_skills.why: Turns dependency frontier, blocked proof, and bridge pressure into typed exploration inputs.

reference_skills.name: abducer-failure-signal-cartographer
reference_skills.why: Separates failures, discovery signals, opportunities, and open questions before candidate generation.

reference_skills.name: kb-induce
reference_skills.why: Finds repeated structures and candidate regularities that seed the hypothesis exploration map.

reference_skills.name: kb-abduce
reference_skills.why: Generates missing-premise, bridge-object, and mediator hypotheses from conceptual pressure.

reference_skills.name: kb-deduce
reference_skills.why: Derives conservative consequences and local proof obligations from accepted candidates.

reference_skills.name: kb-contradiction-strategist
reference_skills.why: Creates proof-by-contradiction branches with exact negations, preserved commitments, contradiction carriers, and proof obligations.

reference_skills.name: kb-concept-bridge-planner
reference_skills.why: Native home for mediation, preservation, and bridge-object obligations.

reference_skills.name: kb-gap-abstraction-conjecturer
reference_skills.why: Native home for missing abstractions and mechanism-like mathematical candidates.

reference_skills.name: abducer-mediation-candidate-generator
reference_skills.why: Generates grounded creative transformations over the hypothesis exploration space.

reference_skills.name: kb-promising-direction-assessor
reference_skills.why: Ranks creative continuations by value, tractability, and expected contribution to the target.

reference_skills.name: kb-discovery-cycle
reference_skills.why: Compiles accepted candidates into proof queue or discovery branch queue artifacts.

reference_skills.name: kb-prove-cycle
reference_skills.why: Tests theorem-shaped obligations and produces blocked-result evidence.

reference_skills.name: kb-revision-loop
reference_skills.why: Receives failure certificates that demand ontology or representation repair.

reference_skills.name: entailment-gap-auditor
reference_skills.why: Checks whether a creative candidate actually supports the claimed successor route.

reference_skills.name: premise-completeness-prober
reference_skills.why: Finds missing assumptions and hidden obligations before candidate promotion.

reference_skills.name: contradiction-route-auditor
reference_skills.why: Audits reductio branches for exact negation, same-theory preservation, accepted conflict targets, and excluded cases before proof-queue promotion.

reference_skills.name: abducer-obligation-gatekeeper
reference_skills.why: Turns creative candidates into preservation, target, non-collapse, barrier, source, and proof-readiness gates.

reference_skills.name: counterfactual-route-prober
reference_skills.why: Tests whether candidate rankings are robust to removed evidence, alternative mediators, and failed route assumptions.

reference_skills.name: epistemic-status-ledger
reference_skills.why: Records whether each hypothesis-space object is conjectural, obligation-backed, proof-queued, blocked, rejected, or promoted.

reference_skills.name: abducer-refinement-route-ranker
reference_skills.why: Ranks validated candidates into proof queue, discovery branch, revision, evidence, quarantine, reject, or stop dispositions.

reference_skills.name: kb-end-to-end-proof-critic
reference_skills.why: Checks whether candidate chains support proof progress or only narrative plausibility.

reference_skills.name: work
reference_skills.why: Owns bounded conceptual refinement inside the Abducer outer loop.
